title: SSRF via URL fetch features
summary: Prove the server fetches attacker-controlled URLs and hits an internal/canary target.
steps: Locate webhook/import/proxy/preview/url params from the map.
Point to engagement Collaborator/Interactsh or internal metadata IP only if in RoE.
Observe out-of-band hit or response body reflecting internal content.
Do not pivot freely into unrelated internal networks beyond RoE.
On PASS: OOB correlation or internal content in response with request evidence.
kill_signals: Allowlist blocks; no OOB; no internal bleed
